title: Literal full K even-sector source observability diagnostics

historical_m8_crosscheck.scope: separate numerical diagnostic; not an Arb certificate

method.theta_G: same finite theta-G sum and m,dps cutoff as full_center_probe.gaussian_plane; D^(2k) derivatives evaluated by the exact polynomial recurrence
method.Fourier_projection: c_n=(-1)^n*2/sqrt(log m)*integral_0^(log m/2) G^(2k)(t) cos(2*pi*n*t/log m) dt, n=-m..m; then orthogonal projection to reflection-even sector
method.rayleigh: v^T (Q^T K Q) v / (v^T v) for projected even-sector coordinates v

S_m.reason: SOURCE_TRANSFER.md does not define the multirow S_m operator on the lower even eigenspace; no row operator was constructed.

gamma_mr.reason: The singular-value diagnostic needs the restriction of a specified multirow S_m to the lower eigenspace; SOURCE_TRANSFER.md does not define it.

Z_m.reason: The optional reference_rows section measures Z=||zhat|| for finite Robin midpoint rows; this is not a cofinal selected-family result.

E_m.reason: SOURCE_TRANSFER.md defines E through the selected full-row error budget (T4); this probe does not compute that row, its interval/sup energy error, or its tail bound.

E_m_over_Z_m.reason: Finite midpoint Z values are available after augmentation, but the matching selected full-row E bound is not evaluated on these cells.

alpha_m.reason: The optional reference_rows section measures the finite same-K ground angle for Robin midpoint rows; no eventual rate is established.

lambda2_minus_lambda1.basis: least-squares slope of log(abs(value)) against log(m)

lambda3_minus_lambda1.basis: least-squares slope of log(abs(value)) against log(m)

rayleigh_D0_G.basis: least-squares slope of log(abs(value)) against log(m)

rayleigh_D8_G.basis: least-squares slope of log(abs(value)) against log(m)

limitations: mpmath quadrature and eigensolver outputs are not interval enclosures.
The theta-G series uses the finite cutoff copied from full_center_probe.gaussian_plane.
Eigenpair residuals validate the numerical eigensolver result, not matrix quadrature error.
Four-cell log-log fits are exploratory and establish no asymptotic rate.
No selected-source S_m-based observability or source-transfer conclusion is made.
